thread:
dmitri: Quick recap from the kernel sweep I ran this morning — A100/H100/L40S across seq=128..16384, batch sizes 1/4/8/16/32. Observed a reproducible microburst on H100 with the fused-paged Flash variant at seq=4096, batch=4. p95 jumps ~3.2x for a ~200ms tail. KV-cache util spikes right before the burst. Attaching traces.

perf-bot: auto-summary: H100 fused-paged flash | seq=4096 batch=4 | p50=18ms p95=78ms p99=215ms | baseline (fused-only) p95=24ms

maya: ugh. any flamegraphs or perf scripts? :thinking:

dmitri: flamegraph here: https://s3.internal/reports/attn/2245678910/fg-h100-fused-paged-4096b4.svg

wei: can you paste the hot stacks? my initial hunch is evictor/prefetch interplay causing KV eviction churn.

dmitri: stack dump (trimmed):
```
0x7f3a2b kernel_flash_paged_fused
0x7f3a2f prefetch_kv_range
0x7f3b10 kv_cache_evictor::evict_if_needed
0x7f3b55 request_scanner::schedule_prefetch
0x7f3c00 runtime_request_handler
```

lee: I ran a quick variant with PREFETCH=0 on H100 (same seq/batch). Spike disappears, p95 ~26ms. So prefetch seems correlated. Command I used:
```
BENCH_DEVICE=h100 ./run_attn_bench --model gpt2 --seq 4096 --batch 4 --variant fused-paged --prefetch 0
```

simon: were there any kernel merges recently touching prefetch/kvcache scheduling? I can start a git-bisect if we have a commit range.

dmitri: good idea. suspect range is between c4a8e2 -> d1f9b7 (last two weeks). I'll kick off a bisect tomorrow if nobody beats me to it.

aj: I'll repro on L40S and A100 with prefetch toggled and a capped KV cache (2GB) to see if cap changes behavior. Scheduling now.

perf-bot: job queued: bench-2245678910-repro (H100,A100,L40S) — expect ~90m. Link: https://ci.internal/jobs/bench-2245678910

maya: if prefetch is the trigger, disabling by default until we have adaptive heuristics might be safer for canary.

wei: alternative: lower prefetch window for mid-long seqs, or add spike detector that throttles prefetch when KV evictions/sec > threshold.

lee: note: disabling prefetch reduces steady-state throughput for long batches on A100; tradeoff needs quantifying. I'll run throughput sweep after aj's run.

dmitri: plan: 1) run bisect for kernel patches 2) aj/lee run cross-device with prefetch toggles + kv cap 3) add perf monitors for eviction/sec and prefetch queue depth on canary. Ping me if you want access to traces.

maya: thanks — ping when bisect starts.

simon: volunteering to inspect bisect results / test candidate commits.

dmitri: appreciated. I'll post interim bisect notes in this thread when I have the first bad commit. For now, tagging infra to keep an eye on dedicated clusters: @infra-team

perf-bot: note: saved profile artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/attn/2245678910/ — includes flamegraphs, pprof, and raw traces.

maya: ok cool. next step: set canary prefetch=off in staging for 24h and collect metrics. If tail clears, schedule rollback of prefetch by default.

dmitri: sounds good. logging the action items in the runbook now.
